en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Four, there is no cutting upon them – the embezzler, and the unfaithful (of trust), and the one who steals from the war booty, and the employee thief, for these are treachery’.
